guardOfflinePaidReservations treats a failed offline_receipt lookup as 'paid' (hold, never a fresh charge); if SQLite were unreadable the run stays held in its journal row rather than terminal — the sweep re-records the same failure each pass (no network traffic). On a SCORED complete result the commit transaction verifies the journal is still reserve_pending with permitId null (and assertCurrentAttempt for original), saves the analysis record, computes fullOutputSha256 = sha256Hex(originalCanonicalJson(record.result)), calls consumeOfflineAllocation({operationId, resultId, fullOutputSha256, grantId}, reading) (refusing replayed/mismatched receipts), then repository.saveOfflineAnalysis(db, analysis, receiptId) writes local_shot (verifying the queued receipt names this result) and NO shot.sync outbox row; abstention/low-confidence/technique-confirmation persist locally via saveLocalOnlyAnalysis + requestRelease('low_confidence') and consume nothing; no policy/no grant/explicit refusal fall through to the unchanged honest no-score path. `readOfflineScoredReplay()` returns the durable paid rating (receipt + record + shot digest all verified against fullOutputSha256) for replays of the same operation and for a commit whose SQLite ack was lost, on both plain and original paths (prior-round break #3). (2) offlineCapabilities.ts — readOfflineReceiptForOperation, readHeldOfflineGrantJws, paidOfflineOperationIds (UUID-validated, deduped, capped at 100). (3) offlineWallet.ts — wireEntry builds the 1.0 entry {…flat fields, receipt, grant:{schemaVersion:'offline-signed-grant-v1' (OFFLINE_SIGNED_GRANT_SCHEMA_VERSION), compactJws: held grant JWS whose sha256 must equal receipt.grantJwsSha256}, output: exact local_shot payload minus analysisPermitId, or null when the stored payload no longer hashes to fullOutputSha256}; entries are assembled BEFORE the presentation is journaled so a missing/corrupt grant row throws with nothing sent and no in_flight row (prior-round P3); accepted (result_recorded) verdicts write sync_receipt('shot.sync', resultId) exactly like a successful shot.sync; held stays pending; refused stays refused. (4) api.ts — additive `OfflineReceiptWireEntry extends OfflineReceiptSubmission`. (5) syncRuntime.ts (out-of-scope, justified) — recovery excludes paidOfflineOperationIds so a paid-offline operation is never re-reserved live/finalized failed (prior-round break #2).
